breakdown.description: A shock is treated as isentropic; shocks are irreversible and cause a loss in stagnation pressure.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification makes no mention of the isentropic/non-isentropic nature of the shock, nor does it address the stagnation pressure behavior across the shock. It simply states that downstream flow velocity V2 should be included in results, which is entirely unrelated to correcting the fundamental error of treating a shock as isentropic with constant stagnation pressure. The inconsistency is not resolved.
